note: Honorifics dropped; 'John 1. White' OCR read as John I. White. Guidance staff entries carry building in the role (Counselor/High School=high, /Middle School=middle, /Elementary School=passios, inferred from 1972 Passios+Annex naming); Guidance secretary and Special Services staff serve all grades=district-wide. 'Department Heads, Teachers & Supervisors - Senior High School' heading begins line 20-21; the people under it are listed as high but several teach Grade 8 (Aldrich, Besarkarski, Eacmen on p104, Cormier) - the printed heading is Senior High School (grades 8-12 share the building), so high is used throughout. Donald Adams entry lines 22-25. Line 1 column header ignored. Integration pass, 31 Oct 2026: school bus contractors, drivers and volunteers moved from entries to ignored (not school staff; every 1971-1980 page treated alike), and `middle` written `turkey-hill` -- the 1972 and 1974 listings print the building as `Turkey Hill Middle School (Grades 5-7)`, the town's one middle school.
